rules: MEASURED means published observational input, including inherited reduction, never a native derivation; missing errors stay OPEN.
DECLARED counts every assumption/category separately from fitted scalar coordinates and empirical information.
COMPUTED is scoped to the original native/conditional object, not automatic physical applicability.
OPEN entries have no selected value; null is not zero and no branch is silently chosen.
Alpha shift and rest-reference route overlap; energy/time share a rescaling dependence. No duplicated scalar count without an actual map.
A newly fitted independent M/L plus independently fitted A would exceed the one-coordinate slot; correlations and native relations must be proved, not asserted.
No target velocity or desired radial law may select states, coefficients, source shape, maps, approximations or stopping.
Future accepted providers must add every newly exposed parameter/function/data dependency; this is the complete current cited debt inventory, not a claim about unknown future theory.
